payload.title: A workspace settles on its drafting provider
payload.context: M5 review (#5), extends ADR 0013: a workspace following the instance default would silently move to another vendor when the operator changed the default.
payload.rationale: The provider is fixed on the workspace when an owner chooses, stores a key for the provider in use, or the first draft is requested. A brief never moves to another vendor without an owner action.
payload.consequences: There is no setting to follow the default again. Timed-out draft requests now count towards the daily caps (ADR 0012).
